title: Bhutan Over the Dochula Pass to Phobjikha
alt: The hundred and eight chortens at the Dochula pass
transport: Private vehicle, driver and licensed guide throughout

stops.name: Thimphu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel in the capital, walkable to the clock tower

activities.name: Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong
activities.match: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour with Simtokha Dzong
activities.description: The capital on foot and by road, finishing at Simtokha Dzong, the oldest fortress still standing in the country.

program.name: Thimphu
program.description: Days in the capital, with the Memorial Chorten, the Buddha Dordenma and Tashichho Dzong.

stops.name: Phobjikha
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple lodge on the edge of the Phobjikha valley

activities.name: Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley
activities.description: Gangtey Goemba on its low ridge above the Phobjikha valley, the winter ground of the black necked cranes.

program.name: Phobjikha
program.description: Time on the edge of the Phobjikha valley, the winter ground of the black necked cranes.

stops.name: Punakha
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Riverside hotel in the warm old winter capital

activities.name: Punakha sightseeing tour
activities.description: The fortress where Bhutan’s kings are crowned, built on the spit of land where two rivers meet below the town.

program.name: Punakha
program.description: Time in the warm old winter capital, with the Dzong between two rivers and the suspension bridge.

stops.name: Paro
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel in the valley below Taktsang

activities.name: Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang
activities.match: Paro Sightseeing Tour with Kyichu Lhakhang
activities.description: A guided day around Paro finishing at Kyichu Lhakhang, one of the oldest temples standing in Bhutan.

activities.name: Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong
activities.match: Visit to Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong
activities.description: The round watchtower that now holds the National Museum, and the whitewashed Rinpung fortress above the river.

activities.name: Hike to the Tiger's Nest
activities.description: The climb to Taktsang, the monastery wedged into a cliff nine hundred metres above the Paro valley floor.

program.name: Paro
program.description: Days in the valley below Taktsang, with Rinpung Dzong, the National Museum and the Tiger’s Nest hike.

day_titles.5: To Paro: Paro and Kyichu Lhakhang
day_titles.6: Ta dzong and rinpung dzong and tiger's nest hike

1: Arrival at Paro International and transfer to Thimphu
The road east along the Pa Chhu and the Wang Chhu
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
3: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
On through Wangdue towards the Phobjikha valley
Gangtey Goemba on its low ridge
The crane valley spread out below
4: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
5: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
A guided round of the Paro valley
Kyichu Lhakhang, among the oldest temples in Bhutan
6: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The round watchtower holding the National Museum
Rinpung Dzong on the slope above the river
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Flying into Paro and heading straight for Thimphu saves you two long days on the road from Siliguri.
expert.tip: Stop at the Dochula cafeteria for a bowl of ema datshi. On a clear day the whole eastern Himalaya lines up behind the chortens.

summary: 7 days through Thimphu, Phobjikha, Punakha, Paro, with 6 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the gangtey and the phobjikha valley, the punakha sightseeing tour, the paro sightseeing with kyichu lhakhang.
included: Included: 6 nights across Thimphu, Phobjikha, Punakha, Paro with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
